name: shared-checkout-guard
description: Advisory-only (never blocks) reminder printed at git commit time when the working tree has unstaged-modified or untracked content not part of the commit. Direct response to a real, recurring failure (hit 3+ times in one session): editing/committing in a checkout another concurrent agent was also actively working in, without noticing until well into the work. Deliberately checks at git-commit time with the existing Bash matcher rather than at edit time, which would need unverified per-provider Edit/Write tool-matcher research -- commit time is where this class of mistake was actually caught in practice every time it happened.
